messages:
incident-bot: Paging — SLO breach detected: p99 latency for /v1/generate > 3s across multiple nodes in us-west-2. Triggered 03:04 UTC. Severity S2.

megan: seeing it in dashboards — p95 ~1.1s, p99 spikes to 4.3s, streaming sessions show stalls/timeout at ~120s for a subset. Lots of open connections.

sanjay: oncall here, ack. grabbing logs, paging infra. Is there a recent rollout?

irene: deploy-bot shows a model rollout started at 03:02 UTC — model-redwood-v5-quant was shifted to 10% canary traffic. Could be correlated.

luis: quick grep of pod logs shows recurring KV cache eviction warnings and a new error pattern: "kv_lock_timeout: waited > 500ms". Queue depth on shard-7 jumped.

megan: copying grafana snippets: https://grafana.internal/graph?panelId=901&from=now-30m to illustrate p99 spike.

kevin: also seeing CPU steal on the GPU hosts around the same timestamp, frequency of context-switches climbs. Not definitive but suspicious.

megan: streaming metrics: stalled bytes/stream rising, client RTTs climb during the spike, so both generation tail and stream flush are affected.

sanjay: immediate mitigation plan: 1) pause canary traffic to v5, 2) route canary traffic to fallback model v4, 3) scale up healthy pools if needed. Who can pause the rollout?

irene: I can pause. Running \`deployctl rollout pause model-redwood-v5-quant --env=prod --region=us-west-2\`.

deploy-bot: Received command: "pause rollout model-redwood-v5-quant". Pausing canary (10%->0%). Changes queued, applying to routers.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused. 10% traffic routed back to model-redwood-v4 (pinned) in us-west-2.

luis: after rollout pause, observed KV lock errors drop significantly in the logs within ~45s. Queue depth returning to baseline.

oncall-sre: metrics update: p95 now ~240ms, p99 ~620ms for /v1/generate in us-west-2 — still slightly elevated but trending down.

megan: customer impact note: some customers on us-west-2 active sessions experienced degraded streaming for ~6-9 minutes during the peak. Support ticket INC-7891 created and linked to this thread.

kevin: can someone capture the exact host list that served v5 during canary? need to check kernel/driver versions.

irene: pulling canary host list: host-32, host-33, host-34. All three show the kv_lock_timeout traces.

luis: small snippet from logs: ```
2026-03-15T03:03:01Z host-33 model-redwood-v5-quant WARN kv_lock_timeout key=batcher-evict wait=523ms
2026-03-15T03:03:02Z host-33 model-redwood-v5-quant ERROR stream_flush stalled session_id=abcd-1234 duration=118s
```

megan: agreed next steps for immediate ops: 1) keep v5 paused, 2) mark v5 rollout blocked and revert canary config, 3) collect perf traces from host-32..34, 4) open infra ticket to investigate kernel/driver/quantization interaction.

sanjay: I'm creating the incident ticket now and assigning owners. Incident owner: megan, infra lead: kevin, model lead: irene, SRE contact: luis.

incident-bot: Incident updated — status: mitigated -> monitoring. Mitigation action: canary paused, traffic pinned to v4. Incident started 3039991234, mitigated 3039991540.

oncall-sre: confirm mitigation results: 10m after pause p95/p99 holding stable under SLO. No additional customer-impact reports in support queue for the last 8m.

megan: we'll schedule a postmortem; immediate RCA hypotheses: v5 quantization exposed a hot-path contention in KV cache layer under certain request shapes, causing tail stalls in streaming.

irene: initial reproduction attempt on staging with same model quant flags reproduced increased KV contention under parallel streaming load. Filing model bug: MODEL-341.

kevin: infra checklist — check host driver versions and nv_peer_mem, compare GC/oom logs, and run kernel perf on host-33.

luis: deploying additional observability: enabled debug-level kv metrics for shard-7 for 2h and added sampling for streaming timeouts.

megan: customer comms: support will send a summary that a canary rollout caused transient streaming degradation and that traffic was rolled back to the previous model; ETA for RCA 48h.

sanjay: handoff: I'm going offline in 15m — handoff to megan & irene for postmortem and model fix coordination. Please paste final timeline when you have it.

deploy-bot: rollback job (explicit) completed: model-redwood-v4 pinned in us-west-2.

incident-bot: Incident closed: status -> monitoring (no active SLO breach). Closed at 3039991960.

megan: thanks all. action items recorded: MODEL-341 (model), INFRA-1782 (host investigation), PM: schedule postmortem, notify sales for customers impacted. :thumbsup:

sanjay: great work. logging this for the weekly ops review.

kevin: will follow up with a kernel-level timeline and attach perf flamegraphs.

luis: leaving a note to run a targeted canary in a test region with controlled traffic shapes before any re-rollout.

irene: added an eval harness to stress the kv cache under streaming loads; will iterate tomorrow.

megan: closing thread for now — reopen if we see regression.
